Understand the technology

A clearer way
to explain clean air.

UV energy, a catalyst, oxygen and moisture power ductFIT’s described photocatalytic oxidation process. Follow the stages in plain language.

See how it works
Step 01

Air brings oxygen and moisture

A built-in fan or the building’s HVAC airflow moves air containing oxygen and water vapour through the system.

Step 02

UV light activates the catalyst

Inside the unit, UV energy activates the catalyst surface. This light-driven reaction is called photocatalytic oxidation.

Step 03

Reactive molecules support treatment

ductFIT describes generating low levels of hydrogen peroxide molecules that act on selected contaminants while the unit operates.

A practical approach

Your needs come first.

Analyze, create and execute: a practical plan for monitoring, purification and the building conditions behind your concerns.

01

Analyze your environment

Understand the space, occupancy and existing HVAC conditions. Use monitoring or third-party IAQ testing when a project needs baseline data.

02

Good questions

Let’s make
the next step simple.

Get answers before choosing a product.

Ask our team
Which product should I start with?

Start with how you will use it: a car, a room without ductwork, a building with HVAC ducts, or air quality monitoring. Our product finder suggests a starting point; the team confirms suitability.

Is KleanSense an air purifier?

KleanSense is an indoor air quality monitor. It measures environmental readings. Choose a purification product separately if your space needs air treatment.

Can an air purifier replace ventilation?

Air cleaning supports an overall air quality plan. Ventilation, control of pollutant sources and appropriate maintenance still matter. The right approach depends on the space and the concern.

How do I get a price or quotation?

Tell us the product or space you are considering using the enquiry page. It prepares a WhatsApp message for you to send, or an email draft if you prefer.
